from google.cloud import vision
from document_client import DocumentClient
from document_models import DocumentRequest, TextExtractionResponse

def extract_text_from_image(image_content: bytes) -> TextExtractionResponse:
    client = DocumentClient()
    image = vision.Image(content=image_content)

    response = client.client.document_text_detection(image=image)
    full_text = response.full_text_annotation.text

    return TextExtractionResponse(text=full_text, full_response=response._pb)

from google.cloud import documentai_v1 as documentai
from document_models import DocumentRequest, TextExtractionResponse
from typing import List, Dict, Any

def extract_layout_from_document(project_id: str, location: str, processor_id: str, document_content: bytes) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    client = documentai.DocumentProcessorServiceClient()
    
    # The full resource name of the processor
    # e.g.: projects/project_id/locations/location/processors/processor_id
    name = client.processor_path(project_id, location, processor_id)

    document = documentai.RawDocument(content=document_content, mime_type='application/pdf')

    request = documentai.ProcessRequest(name=name, raw_document=document)

    result = client.process_document(request=request)
    
    # For layout extraction, the Document object contains the layout information
    return result.document._pb

**Implementing Content Moderation**

I'm now integrating content moderation using `ocr_safety.py` and Google Cloud's Natural Language API. I plan to use this for the detection of potentially offensive content. I will be incorporating this API to enhance content security.

input.content:
from google.cloud import language_v1
from typing import Dict, Any

def analyze_safety_of_text(text_content: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    client = language_v1.LanguageServiceClient()

    document = language_v1.Document(content=text_content, type_=language_v1.Document.Type.PLAIN_TEXT)

    # Available categories: https://cloud.google.com/natural-language/docs/reference/rest/v1/ModerateTextRequest
    response = client.moderate_text(document=document)

    safety_scores = {}
    for category_filter in response.moderation_categories:
        safety_scores[category_filter.name] = category_filter.score
    
    return safety_scores

from google.cloud import documentai_v1 as documentai
from typing import List, Dict, Any

def extract_fields_from_document(project_id: str, location: str, processor_id: str, document_content: bytes) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    client = documentai.DocumentProcessorServiceClient()
    name = client.processor_path(project_id, location, processor_id)

    document = documentai.RawDocument(content=document_content, mime_type='application/pdf')

    request = documentai.ProcessRequest(name=name, raw_document=document)

    result = client.process_document(request=request)
    
    # The Document object contains the extracted entities (fields)
    # The exact structure depends on the processor type and training
    return result.document._pb

**Implementing OCR Embeddings**

I'm now implementing `ocr_embedding.py` to leverage text embeddings through Google Cloud Vertex AI. The focus is now shifting toward integrating Vertex AI for these embedding operations, which is the immediate next step.

input.content:
from google.cloud import aiplatform
from typing import List

def get_text_embedding(project_id: str, location: str, text_content: str) -> List[float]:
    aiplatform.init(project=project_id, location=location)

    # Using the text-embedding-004 model for embedding
    # https://cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/generative/docs/embeddings/get-text-embeddings#gemini-model-code-examples
    model = aiplatform.get_model("text-embedding-004")

    embeddings = model.predict(instances=[{'content': text_content}])
    
    # The embeddings are typically a list of floats
    return embeddings.predictions[0]['embeddings']
